title: The Life of Cover on a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Election
content:
Cover under the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan begins when the trip begins and not when the level was chosen,
so an incident before the vehicle changed hands is not a trip incident at all.

Cover ends when the trip ends, including any approved extension, and a trip that runs past its scheduled return
stays covered on the same level for the late period rather than falling out of cover at the scheduled hour.

Where the guest never chose a level, the quote lapses at the moment the trip begins and the trip runs with no
marketplace protection, the guest carrying the whole of any loss up to the value of the vehicle; the marketplace
does not apply a default level on the guest's behalf.

Cover is limited to the level's maximum trip length, and a trip extended past that length is covered only to the
last covered day, the guest being told which day cover ends on rather than discovering it at a claim.

A trip that ends early ends cover early, and the days not taken are dealt with under the refund rules rather than
by leaving cover running.

An election that has reached the completed or expired state is never reopened, and a correction after that point
is made against the lines that were wrong.

## What the record must show for cover to begin

Cover begins on the trip beneath the election, and the state standing on the Keyturn Trip Booking correlated by
the booking reference is what the marketplace reads before cover starts: the trip must stand in progress. The day
the vehicle actually changed hands is the day recorded on that same booking.

## The same rule as a sequence of moments

| Moment | What is true of the cover |
|---|---|
| The level is chosen | Cover has not begun |
| The vehicle changes hands and the trip begins | Cover begins on the level chosen |
| The trip runs past its scheduled return | Cover continues on the same level through the late period |
| The trip reaches the level's maximum trip length | Cover runs to the last covered day and no further |
| The trip ends, early or at its scheduled hour | Cover ends, and unused days are dealt with under the refund rules |
| No level was ever chosen | The quote lapses when the trip begins, and the trip runs uncovered |

**A hypothetical incident before the handover.** A guest whose level was chosen on a Monday and whose vehicle was
collected on the Thursday reports damage that happened on the Wednesday. That is not a trip incident, because
cover had not begun; the marketplace does not apply a level to it on the guest's behalf.

**A hypothetical trip past the maximum length.** Where the level carries a maximum trip length of 60 whole days
and a trip is extended to 70 days, cover runs to the sixtieth covered day, and the guest is told which day that
is rather than discovering it at a claim.
